items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex up 100 pts, Nifty near 23,300; Nifty Auto rises 1%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.79 per cent and 0.85 per cent, respectively

items.title: Why Tata Sons' ₹11.5-trillion portfolio may fetch a far lower IPO value
items.description: Holding-company discounts and losses at key unlisted ventures could weigh on Tata Sons' IPO valuation, though its diversified portfolio may still command a premium

items.title: Manipal Payment shares off to weak start, list at 3% discount to IPO price
items.description: Manipal Payment's share price listed at ₹330 on the NSE, down 2.6 per cent, and at ₹332 on the BSE, a discount of 2.06 per cent.

items.title: Gold at $10k, SIP flows, smallcaps outlook: Chris Wood's India mkt playbook
items.description: Over a five- or 10-year view, if I were an Indian mutual fund investor, it makes sense to allocate half of your inflows into small- and mid-cap funds, Wood said.

items.title: Six companies make record stock market debut in a day, five end higher
items.description: Five of the six companies ended above their issue prices, led by Karamtara Engineering, as a record number of mainboard firms listed on the stock exchanges in a day

items.title: NSE IPO subscribed 43% on first day as non-institutional investors lead
items.description: The ₹22,560 crore IPO received bids for 38 million shares against 88.6 million on offer, with the non-institutional investor portion subscribed 72 per cent
